explication: Mocktail is a Linux-hosted runtime for the Android Roblox client. The principal workflow is to obtain and verify an APK payload, establish Android-compatible Bionic and JNI behavior, load and run the client, then bridge its platform needs to SDL and host graphics/audio services. Additional runtime branches cover Roblox launch/session integration, web views, authentication, settings, and input. The README supports the high-level workflow; source excerpts show selected entry-point, session, and service relationships, so unsampled internal wiring is not inferred.
